name: forward-deployed-engineering
description: Forward Deployed Engineering field kit for Claude Code: a situation-aware FDE playbook, artifact templates, prototype tours, and engagement tooling.

plugins.name: fde
plugins.description: Classify an engagement on six axes (phase, environment, product, engagement model, starting point, delivery style), then produce the matching FDE artifact: discovery, gap analysis, requirements, prototype and guided tour, pilot and ROI, demo gate review, and handoff.
